title: 相关性 dispatch cache_only 模式失败 — 需先完成独立指标计算
description: 相关性矩阵计算的 cache_only 调度模式失败。根因：相关性计算依赖独立指标（IC / RankIC / Sharpe）作为预条件，但当前流水线没有显式的依赖检查；在独立指标尚未计算的情况下 cache_only 模式查询缓存为空，dispatch 直接失败。修复方向：(a) cache_only 模式下检测到缓存空时自动 fallback 到 compute_then_cache；或 (b) 显式的 dependency check 在 dispatch 前 fail-fast 返回 'standalone_metrics_required' 错误。Phase 2 cluster 计算阻塞于此。从 MEMORY pending_fixes.md 提取。
reproduce_command: curl -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1/correlation/dispatch' -d '{"mode":"cache_only","factor_ids":[...]}'  # fails on missing cache
required_verification: cache_only dispatch on factor with computed standalone metrics succeeds
cache_only dispatch on factor without standalone metrics returns clear error or auto-fallback
closure_requirements: Decision recorded for fallback vs fail-fast policy

events.note: QE Official Eval Unification work; blocks Phase 2 cluster computation
